scope: Physical native iPhone Day grid, actual app touch timestamps from a synthesized lateral drag. Four independent forward/reverse swipes per launch. The first correct visible shift is registered against a still image before the touch. A match needs at least two points in the finger direction, overlapping edge correlation at least .62 and separation .08 from alternatives more than three pixels away. Captured times are sparse. The last unshifted and first shifted frames bracket observed change; neither is a direct 120 Hz presentation timestamp.
